mapper.sql: id, agent_code AS agentCode, agent_name AS agentName, description, scene, system_prompt AS systemPrompt, enabled, built_in AS builtIn, sort_no AS sortNo, create_user AS createUser, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_info ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT FROM agent_info WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT system_prompt FROM agent_info WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_info (agent_code, agent_name, description, scene, system_prompt, enabled, built_in, sort_no, create_user) VALUES (#{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{description}, #{scene}, #{systemPrompt}, #{enabled}, #{builtIn}, #{sortNo}, #{createUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_info SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode}
